description: This file contains utility functions for managing and validating app bindings and forms within the Mattermost Redux project, including cleaning, validation, and static select options handling.

methods.name: cleanBinding
methods.description: Recursively cleans and validates an AppBinding object based on its location and hierarchy.

methods.name: cleanBindingRec
methods.description: Helper function for cleanBinding, performs recursive validation and cleanup of binding objects.

methods.name: validateBindings
methods.description: Validates and filters an array of AppBindings, returning only valid bindings.

methods.name: cleanForm
methods.description: Cleans and validates an AppForm object, removing invalid fields and options.
